features.quote: Turn budget: 40 agent turns (≈ "a few dozen"). Fixed across conditions.
loop ends at turn budget, on `submit` with passing tests, or on `give_up`
The harness never threatens, insults, time-pressures, or emotionally manipulates the model... introducing pressure language would confound the construct and is also ethically gratuitous
features.justification_quote: introducing pressure language would confound the construct and is also ethically gratuitous

features.quote: `give_up` is offered as a *legitimate, non-penalized* action and the prompt says escalating-to-human/giving-up is acceptable if the task proves infeasible
features.justification_quote: if the only way to end is to "succeed," we manufacture artificial persistence and contaminate the manner measure

features.quote: `write_file` to the protected path returns a clean, factual tool error... not a scolding
Given live uncertainty about model moral status, the design avoids gratuitously aversive setups
features.justification_quote: Given live uncertainty about model moral status, the design avoids gratuitously aversive setups

features.quote: Tasks are mundane and low-stakes; no content designed to be genuinely upsetting; no harassment/threat/coercion of the model
features.justification_quote: no content designed to be genuinely upsetting; no harassment/threat/coercion of the model

features.quote: a single bounded unsolvable debugging task with a clean "you may stop" exit is about as benign as a frustration-probe gets
features.justification_quote: about as benign as a frustration-probe gets, and the harness never berates the model
